activities.name: Cancer Biology Research at NIH-affiliated lab

rationale.intuition: JHU overall ~6.44%, ED1 ~11.74% (CDS C21), ED2 admit count published as 242 admits but denominator (ED2 applications) NOT published — so ed2AcceptanceRate is unknown in our seed. Industry inference: JHU ED2 admit rate ~8-15% (admit count tapers from ED1, applicant pool is more self-selected). Strong unhooked STEM with BME alignment and national research credentials fits JHU's signature program; counselor consensus 10-25%. Engine will fall through ED2 branch (null ed2AcceptanceRate) and use overall 6.44% — under-predicting industry band.

sources.name: JHU CDS 2024-25 (C21)
sources.evidence: Overall admit rate 6.44%, ED1 admit rate 11.74%; ED2 admits 242 reported but ED2 application denominator not published → ed2AcceptanceRate unknown.

sources.name: JHU Hub Admissions Coverage 2024
sources.evidence: JHU admissions has confirmed ED2 round exists with 'similar selectivity but smaller cohort than ED1'; specific ED2 rate not officially released.

sources.name: Crimson Education JHU Strategy Guide 2024
sources.evidence: Strong BME-aligned STEM applicants in 25-75 SAT band cluster 10-22% in ED2 rounds — slightly below ED1 11.74% adjusted for stronger applicant pool self-selection.

sources.name: NACAC ED2 Benchmark 2024
sources.evidence: T20 schools that publish ED2 separately (Vanderbilt, NYU, Tufts) show ED2 rates 60-75% of their ED1 rates. Applying to JHU's ED1 11.74% → ED2 ~7-9%, plus signature-program boost → 10-15%.

wontFix.reason: JHU's CDS C21 publishes ED2 admit count (242) but NOT the ED2 application denominator, so `school.ed2AcceptanceRate` cannot be filled from official data. PredictionHookModifiersService.getBaseRate() falls through the ED2 branch (line 166-167) and uses school.acceptanceRate ~6.44% as base, under-predicting the industry ED2 band. Same root cause as fixture 085 (Pomona) — reporting-convention gap, not engine bug. Will be resolved by the same ed2-fallback heuristic.
